verdict.rationale: Avalara offers a 90-day free trial with dedicated API/SDK access and no credit card required, implying a separate test account distinct from production billing, but the evidence never explicitly documents a distinct 'sandbox' base URL/environment or transaction-commit flags for safe testing. missing for 10: explicit sandbox environment documentation (e.g., sandbox.avatax.com), guidance on non-committing test transactions, and confirmation that MCP/agent tools can target the trial/sandbox rather than production.
